display.title: Isru Chag Shavuos: Every Jew Stood at Sinai
display.summary_short: The day after Shavuos: every Jewish soul of every generation stood at Har Sinai, and just as no one was left behind in Egypt, Moshiach will bring every Jew home.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, given on Isru Chag, the day after Shavuos. Uncle Yossi recalls the excitement of coming to shul to hear the Ten Commandments, when everyone, young and old, was there, just like at the first giving of the Torah. Our Sages teach that every Jew of all generations, even those not yet born, was present at Har Sinai, so we are living witnesses that Hashem gave the Torah, and every Shavuos we relive that experience. He then looks forward: just as not a single Jew was left behind when we left Egypt in the year 2448, so in the final redemption Moshiach will gather every Jew from exile to Eretz Yisroel, where the third Beis HaMikdash will be built by Hashem Himself.
display.lesson: Every Jew stood at Har Sinai, and every Jew will be gathered back to Eretz Yisroel with Moshiach.

date.note: 'Here we are, Isru Chag, a day right after Shavuos'.
